"""Read-only completion/transfer verification; never simulates or fits outcomes."""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib, json, platform, socket, subprocess, sys
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / 'scripts'))
import adhd_study as s
from flyonenomics.drive.paired_inputs import VERSION, trial_events
from flyonenomics.io import load_npy

raw = Path('camber-runs/adhd-study/5b-02')
plan, pair = s.read(s.PLAN), s.read(s.PAIR)
expected_commit = 'f28779b2099018f7188de8c7f73234c0c53b828f'
assert int(raw.with_suffix('.exit').read_text()) == 0
assert raw.with_suffix('.commit').read_text().strip() == expected_commit
assert s.sha(s.PAIR) == plan['calibration_reference']['pair_sha256']
assert s.sha(s.CALIBRATION_PLAN) == plan['calibration_reference']['plan_sha256']
expected_names = {f'seed-{seed}{suffix}' for seed in range(201,211)
                  for suffix in ['.json', *[f'-arm-{i:02}.{ext}' for i in range(32) for ext in ('npz','json')]]}
assert {p.name for p in raw.iterdir()} == expected_names
expected_arms = [(c, list(p)) for c in s.analysis.CONDITIONS for p in s.analysis.PROTOCOLS]
a,b = pair['pair']
patterns = {'off':np.zeros(len(plan['source_indices'])),
            'A':np.asarray(plan['encoder']['single_rates_hz'][str(a)]),
            'B':np.asarray(plan['encoder']['single_rates_hz'][str(b)]),
            'AB':np.asarray(plan['encoder']['pairs'][f'{a},{b}']['rates_hz'])}
receipt = {'verified_at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'host':socket.gethostname(),
           'platform':platform.platform(), 'python':platform.python_version(), 'numpy':np.__version__,
           'execution_commit':expected_commit, 'local_checkout_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),
           'plan_sha256':s.sha(s.PLAN),'pair_sha256':s.sha(s.PAIR),'calibration_plan_sha256':s.sha(s.CALIBRATION_PLAN),
           'npz_arms':320,'arm_journals':320,'complete_seed_manifests':10,
           'started_utc':raw.with_suffix('.started').read_text().strip(),
           'finished_utc':raw.with_suffix('.finished').read_text().strip(), 'exit_code':0,
           'seed_audits':[], 'artifacts_sha256':{}}
identity = None
for seed in range(201,211):
    manifest = raw/f'seed-{seed}.json'; run=s.read(manifest)
    assert run['seed']==seed and run['stage']=='5b' and run['brain_seconds']==704
    assert run['plan_sha256']==s.sha(s.PLAN) and run['pair_sha256']==s.sha(s.PAIR)
    assert run['identity']['commit']==expected_commit
    if identity is None: identity=run['identity']
    assert run['identity']==identity
    assert run['identity']['sha256']==plan['identity']['sha256']
    # All file-backed frozen sources present here must still match. Semantic
    # manifest pins are not pathname hashes and are retained verbatim above.
    for name, digest in run['identity']['sha256'].items():
        path=Path(name)
        if path.is_file(): assert s.sha(path)==digest, name
    assert [(r['condition'],r['protocol']) for r in run['rows']]==expected_arms
    s.audit_rows(run['rows'],history=True)
    fixed, finals, event_hashes, final_counts = {}, {}, {}, {}
    for i,row in enumerate(run['rows']):
        file=raw/f'seed-{seed}-arm-{i:02}.npz'; journal=file.with_suffix('.json')
        assert row['file']==file.name and s.sha(file)==row['sha256']
        j=s.read(journal)
        assert {k:j[k] for k in ('seed','stage','identity','plan_sha256','pair_sha256')} == {k:run[k] for k in ('seed','stage','identity','plan_sha256','pair_sha256')}
        assert j['row']==row
        assert row['male_array_binding']==plan['male_array_binding']
        assert row['rng_hash_method']=='brian-runtime-next-draws-v1'
        assert row['input_plumbing_version']==VERSION and row['actual_events_equal_fixed_list'] is True
        assert row['response_window_s']==[8.,10.] and row['chunk_s']==.01 and row['dt_ms']==.1
        protocol=tuple(row['protocol'])
        if protocol not in fixed:
            fixed[protocol]=trial_events(s.MASTER,seed,'5b',protocol,patterns,plan['timing'],row['dt_ms'])
        with load_npy(file,allow_pickle=False) as z:
            assert z['er_counts'].shape==(2200,245) and z['tubu_counts'].shape==(2200,156)
            ticks, cells=z['injected_ticks'],z['injected_tubu_positions']
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(ticks,fixed[protocol][0])
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(cells,fixed[protocol][1])
            assert s.digest(np.column_stack((ticks,cells)))==row['planned_injected_events_sha256']
            mask=ticks>=80000; events=np.column_stack((ticks[mask],cells[mask])); label=protocol[1]
            assert s.digest(events)==row['injected_test_events_sha256']
            if label in finals: np.testing.assert_array_equal(events,finals[label])
            finals[label]=events;event_hashes[label]=s.digest(events);final_counts[label]=len(events)
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(z['response_er_hz'],z['er_counts'][800:1000].sum(axis=0)/2)
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(z['response_tubu_hz'],z['tubu_counts'][800:1000].sum(axis=0)/2)
        receipt['artifacts_sha256'][file.name]=s.sha(file)
        receipt['artifacts_sha256'][journal.name]=s.sha(journal)
    receipt['artifacts_sha256'][manifest.name]=s.sha(manifest)
    receipt['seed_audits'].append({'seed':seed,'arms':32,
        'initial_rng_sha256':sorted({r['rng_initial_sha256'] for r in run['rows']}),
        'final_rng_sha256':sorted({r['rng_final_sha256'] for r in run['rows']}),
        'final_stimulus_event_sha256':event_hashes,'final_stimulus_event_counts':final_counts,
        'all_actual_events_equal_regenerated_fixed_lists':True,'all_same_final_stimulus_arrays_exactly_equal':True,
        'journal_manifest_and_npz_hashes_match':True})
    print(f'verified seed {seed}: exact RNG/event/list/binding checks passed',file=sys.stderr,flush=True)
receipt['status_files_sha256']={p.name:s.sha(p) for p in sorted(raw.parent.glob('5b-02.*')) if p.is_file()}
receipt['all_prerequisites_passed']=True
print(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2))
